subject: MAP update — proposed close reprofiling and safeguard plan
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, 21 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delay in internal approvals — impact on MAP and close timeline

Jordan —

Quick heads-up from procurement: our security steering committee pushed our review of the vendor questionnaire to next week (they re-prioritized a compliance audit). That means the internal signoff milestone in our MAP (scheduled 3/28) will slip at least two weeks unless we escalate.

Two asks: can Redwood pause any billing windows tied to the original go-live? And do you have a contingency MAP we can review that assumes a late-April close?

I attached the procurement request that triggered the hold (procurement_redline.pdf). We still want this to close — just need a realistic reprofiling so stakeholders stay aligned.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Director, IT Procurement
AtlasHealth

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Mar 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delay in internal approvals — impact on MAP and close timeline

Maya —

Thanks for the update and for sending the redline. I reviewed with our delivery team; we can accommodate a late-April go-live but want to lock a few safeguards so the slip doesn't cascade:

- Proposed reprofiling: move Acceptance Sign-off -> 2029-04-24, Production Cutover -> 2029-04-30.
- Interim sandbox: extend sandbox access by 2 weeks at no charge.
- One-off onboarding credit: pending internal approval, we can offer up to a 10% onboarding credit tied to acceptance.
- Legal: we can accept the procurement redline items marked non-critical; anything that changes SLAs will need a quick legal redline.

I've attached a reprofiling MAP draft (MAP_v2.xlsx) with new milestones and responsibilities. Can you confirm procurement's target acceptance window (late-April) and whether your steering committee needs an exec-level note from Redwood?

If you confirm by EOD Friday (3/22) we'll fast-track the credit approval and loop in Legal for the DocuSign draft.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Fri, 22 Mar 2029 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delay in internal approvals — impact on MAP and close timeline

Jordan —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the sandbox extension offer. Steering committee can accept the late-April acceptance window (target 4/24) so your dates look good from our side.

A couple of constraints to highlight:
- We have a procurement freeze on new recurring costs approvals until 4/10; any credits must be pre-authorized by vendor finance.
- Legal will need the final SOW and a redline within 48 hours of the signoff milestone.

We would like an exec note (brief) that outlines the revised MAP and the one-off credit so our steering committee can sign off quickly. Can you provide that and the DocuSign link once legal redlines are in place?

-Maya

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Mar 2029 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: AtlasHealth reprofiling — request for credit approval and legal prep

LAURA / BEN —

Context: AtlasHealth's steering committee deferred the vendor questionnaire; procurement expects an approval freeze until 4/10 which pushes their acceptance milestone to ~4/24. I proposed: 2-week sandbox extension + up to 10% onboarding credit (one-time) to keep the deal momentum. MAP_v2.xlsx attached.

Decision needed:
- Laura: can you approve the 10% onboarding credit (paperwork attached: credit_approval_form.pdf)? This will be recognized as a sales discount against the first invoice.
- Ben: please prepare a redline of the SOW and highlight any SLA changes that are non-negotiable (we should avoid changing token retention terms).

If approval is provided by end of day Friday (3/22), I will send an exec note to AtlasHealth and seed the DocuSign envelope. If not, we risk losing the late-April window and may need to re-open procurement conversation.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Mar 2029 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP update — proposed close reprofiling and safeguard plan

Maya —

Thanks for confirmation. Quick update from our side after internal approvals: 

1) Credit: Exec approved a one-time 10% onboarding credit applied to the first invoice. Finance has routed the credit; paperwork attached (credit_approval_form.pdf).
2) MAP_v2 finalized: Acceptance -> 2029-04-24; Cutover -> 2029-04-30. MAP_v2.xlsx attached (final).
3) Sandbox: 2-week sandbox extension is active; your team has access through 2029-04-14.
4) Legal & DocuSign: Ben flagged two minor SLA clarifications (non-technical) and I uploaded the redlined SOW to DocuSign. Please sign here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/123abc

Exec note (short) included in the DocuSign packet for the steering committee. If anything shifts on your end, please loop me immediately so we can re-evaluate credit recognition and potential interim acceptance criteria.

Looking forward to closing this with you — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, credit_approval_form.pdf
